_comment: Stop IDs of the Manhattan/Brooklyn/Queens terminals each railroad runs into. A train heading to one of these is city-bound; anything else is outbound. Derived from the LIRR and Metro-North stop tables, cross-checked against the termini actually appearing in the live feeds. GTFS directionId cannot do this job: it is absent on ~32% of LIRR trips and is 0 for every Metro-North trip regardless of direction.
